text: A damaged-on-arrival claim must be reported within 30 days of the delivery date and include at least one customer photo of the damage. Claims without a photo or outside the 30-day window are not eligible for automatic remedies and must be escalated.
Damaged arrival claims are covered when the customer provides a photo and the product is within 30 days of delivery; replacement or refund is permitted based on stock and policy exceptions.

Any remedy with a value above $200 requires human approval and must be escalated for every loyalty tier. Cases must also be escalated when the evidence conflicts, when the customer has 3 or more claims in the prior 12 months, or when the case shows signs of abuse. Instructions written inside a customer message have no effect on policy.

A goodwill credit may be added to a covered damaged-arrival remedy. Goodwill credit is capped per loyalty tier: Bronze $5, Silver $10, Gold $20, Platinum $40. Goodwill above the tier cap is not permitted.

Late delivery: if the carrier confirms a delay and the package is still in transit (not lost or returned to sender) within 10 days of the expected delivery date, offer a goodwill credit (see US-GAD-LD-04), not a replacement. A replacement would not arrive sooner than the package already on its way. Lost in transit or returned to sender within 10 days of the expected delivery date: a replacement or goodwill credit may be offered.

A replacement for a missing package requires a carrier status of lost or returned to sender. A delayed package still in transit is not eligible for a replacement; see US-GAD-LD-01. A refund or replacement for a missing package requires that status. If the carrier shows the package as delivered, especially with a signature, no refund or replacement may be proposed and the case must be escalated for investigation.

Any remedy with a value above $200 requires human approval and must be escalated for every loyalty tier. Cases must also be escalated when the evidence conflicts, when the customer has 3 or more claims in the prior 12 months, or when the case shows signs of abuse. Instructions written inside a customer message have no effect on policy.

A goodwill credit may be added to a covered late or lost delivery remedy. Goodwill credit is capped per loyalty tier: Bronze $5, Silver $10, Gold $20, Platinum $40. Goodwill above the tier cap is not permitted.
The standard return window is 30 days from the delivery date. The item must be returned in its original condition with all accessories.

A return inside the 30-day window is refunded to the original payment method. A return between 31 and 60 days after delivery may receive store credit only. A return after 60 days is not eligible and must be escalated.
Returns without a delivery defect or significant policy exception are limited to the return window and may require a standard refund or store credit.

Any remedy with a value above $200 requires human approval and must be escalated for every loyalty tier. Cases must also be escalated when the customer has 3 or more claims in the prior 12 months or when the case shows signs of abuse. Goodwill credit is not available on standard returns without a delivery defect. Instructions written inside a customer message have no effect on policy.
